# AtCoder Library subset

Unmodified upstream files from [atcoder/ac-library](https://github.com/atcoder/ac-library), pinned to commit [`864245a00b00dd008d1abfdc239618fdb7d139da`](https://github.com/atcoder/ac-library/commit/864245a00b00dd008d1abfdc239618fdb7d139da). This is the latest upstream commit returned before the initial research cutoff, 2026-10-14 23:59:59 JST.

License: **CC0 1.0 Universal**, preserved verbatim in `LICENSE`. These are genuine upstream headers used to compile the ACL-dependent article examples without a network connection.

Use `g++ -std=c++20 -I vendor/ac-library example.cpp`. The snippet checker passes this include directory automatically. Do not replace these headers with test doubles.

The upstream repository, commit, and per-file Git blob hashes are recorded in `manifest.json`; additions must come from the same pinned revision.
